title: Terms of the site
introduction: By accessing Plocos you accept the terms, conditions and reader pact that protect this archive and guide its responsible use.

sections.heading: I. THE COGNITIVE PACT (MANIFESTO AND EDITORIAL NATURE)
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

Plocos is an independent ecosystem dedicated to dissecting reality, plastic art, interactive literature, and philosophical analysis. The objective of this domain is not to please, anaesthetise, or shelter the sensitivities of the visitor, but to foster deep reflection and the exposition of the human condition in all its dimensions.
Access to and consumption of the work published here is a voluntary act. Upon entering, the visitor accepts that:
1. They assume the psychological and emotional weight of their own interpretation.
2. They acknowledge the taxonomy of the content: the portal includes unfiltered analysis of the human psyche, anatomical representations (under the strict context of aesthetic appreciation), direct questioning of structural dogmas, and explicit language used as a tool of narrative precision.
3. They understand the analytical boundary: the exposition of a complex, violent, or disruptive subject matter for analysis does not constitute its promotion or apologia.
It is not assumed that exposure to these materials produces comfort. Whoever finds the content emotionally unbearable should stop navigating.

sections.heading: II. TRANSACTIONAL NATURE AND LEGAL CAPACITY
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

Unlike a passive archive, Plocos sustains its curatorial and intellectual rigour through a commercial model. This domain operates with direct profit motive as a support platform for the sale of interactive virtual literature, subscriptions, exclusive memberships, and other editorial services.
Legal capacity: the creation of accounts, the acquisition of subscriptions, and the purchase of works require that the user be of legal age (18 years) and have full legal capacity.
Access by minors: the access to texts or diagrams available for free consultation by minors is under the strict and non-delegable responsibility of their legal guardians, who assume the implications of exposure to the sensitive content described in the Cognitive Pact. No data collection is performed for age verification in non-transactional areas.

sections.heading: III. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ARCHITECTURE AND LICENSING
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

Every work hosted on this domain —including the interactive virtual book, essays, aphorisms, manifestos, photographs of plastic works (such as acrylics on canvas), diagrams, and drafts— is the exclusive intellectual property of its author and is protected by Colombian legislation (Ley 23 de 1982, Decisión Andina 486) and the Berne Convention.
Consumption licence, not ownership: the payment of a subscription or the purchase of virtual literature grants exclusively a temporary licence (in the case of subscriptions) or perpetual (in definitive purchases), personal, revocable, and non-transferable, to access the content. It does not, in any case, constitute a transfer of economic or moral rights.
In-progress works clause: access to unfinished literary projects, drafts, or exclusive fragments turns the subscriber into an early reader. The leaking, screenshotting, copying, or unauthorised distribution of these texts violates professional secrecy and future exploitation rights, enabling the collection of damages.
Prohibition of derivative works: it is strictly forbidden to use the text or visual art hosted as a basis for derivative works, translations, adaptations, or decontextualisations without a written licensing contract.

sections.heading: IV. ANTI-AI PROTECTION AND DATA MINING PROHIBITION
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

In response to contemporary extractivist logics, a strict technical and legal fence is established. The content of Plocos is published exclusively for human cognitive consumption.
The use, extraction, scraping (automated or selective web scraping), and mass collection of any text, image, structure, or metadata from this portal for the development, training, fine-tuning, or evaluation of Artificial Intelligence models (LLMs), image generators, or machine learning systems is absolutely prohibited. This prohibition applies to public entities, private corporations, intermediaries, and dataset builders. The portal implements technical countermeasures and will pursue civilly any elusion of the same.

sections.heading: V. PAYMENT, RETRACTION AND REFUND POLICY
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

Every commercial transaction within Plocos is governed by the Colombian Consumer Statute (Ley 1480/2011).
Right of retraction: the user may exercise their right of retraction within five (5) business days following the purchase of a subscription, requesting the reversal of the payment.
Exceptions: the right of retraction will not apply to the purchase of digital goods (such as complete and immediate access to the interactive virtual book or content downloads) when the execution of the service has begun with the prior and express consent of the consumer, making technical return impossible.

sections.heading: VI. ETHICAL LIMITATIONS, INTERACTION AND EXPULSION
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

The intellectual freedom of this space does not shelter harmful anarchy.
The user commits not to use any interactive section (comments, subscriber forums) to host illegal material, promote physical harm, terrorism, child exploitation, or unfounded legal defamation.
The administration reserves the inalienable right to moderate or remove interventions that fracture the editorial line, without this constituting censorship.
Revocation: access will be revoked, accounts suspended, and subscriptions cancelled immediately and without right to refund for whoever violates intellectual property, eludes anti-AI protections, fraudulently distributes access credentials, or violates the ethical limits set forth.

sections.heading: VII. DIGITAL SOVEREIGNTY AND PRIVACY
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

Plocos operates under the principle of minimum collection. The processing of personal data, strictly necessary for payment processing, subscription administration, and delivery of works, is carried out in accordance with Ley 1581/2012 and its regulatory decrees. Visitors are not ideologically profiled and databases are not commercialised. The rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition (ARCO) may be exercised through the official contact channels detailed in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: VIII. APPLICABLE LAW AND JURISDICTION
sections.body:
[EN: TODO legal review by Colombian attorney]

These conditions are interpreted and enforced under the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any controversy, dispute, or claim that exceeds direct conciliation mechanisms will be submitted to the jurisdiction of the competent judges and courts of the city of Cartagena de Indias, Distrito Turístico y Cultural. The nullity of one clause will not invalidate the scaffolding of the rest of the document.
